ValidationRule.description: Restrict Account Relationship updates for MDs system contacts and prompt to contact Product Support
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( $Profile.Name <> "API Only User", $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", RecordType.Name = "MoveDocs User", ISCHANGED(AccountId), NOT(ISNEW()) )
